hop-warp.title: Hop Warp - Jump, Warp, and Conquer!
hop-warp.description: Dive into the mind-bending adventure of Hop Warp, where you jump, warp, and conquer treacherous levels. Master the art of interdimensional exploration and collect stars to complete each round. Experience unique gameplay as you transform into a sparkling star to navigate through walls. Ready to challenge your tactical skills? Play Hop Warp now!

HomeIframe.title: Hop Warp - Free Online Game
HomeIframe.description: Jump, warp, and conquer in Hop Warp! Navigate treacherous levels, master the art of warping, and become the ultimate interdimensional explorer. Play now!

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Hop Warp is an adventure of a small character navigating closed mazes. Experience a mind-bending platformer where dimensions collide and transform into a sparkling star to collect all the stars.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Move: Use the arrow or WASD keys.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Change: Press the X key or spacebar to transform into a star.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Note: Red walls and areas block transformations.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Collect all the stars in each level by jumping and warping through dimensions.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Transform into a sparkling star to move through walls and navigate complex mazes.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Strategically use limited transformations to complete each level.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Explore mind-bending levels designed to test your skills and creativity.
